g.text: Three maps × three training seeds per environment; all main Q tables start at zero.
Budgets and learning-rate schedules differ. This tests policy quality, not a controlled size or speed scaling law.
Tiny baseline/16×16 bars may be below 0.01%; full precision is retained in the numerical tables.
